items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I was on one job out there with him... if myself or Ash Hardy, didn't have a steady job, we'd call him up and he'd say, 'Oh, yes, you're not working this Saturday, okay I got a job for you.'

ctx.x: Mr. Blakeney, tell us a little bit about the movies and the conditions at that time for black musicians, mainly in the silent movies at that time.
We did quite a bit of work in silent movies, and one of the social hour jobs out there was Satchel McVea. (spelling).
Indeed a legend, Mr. Satchel McVea.
